article.headline: Celtics host Hawks Friday for NBA Cup group stage matchup
article.description: Atlanta Hawks (11-6, fourth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Boston Celtics (12-6, second in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Celtics host Hawks Friday for NBA Cup group stage matchup
article.linkText: Celtics host Hawks Friday for NBA Cup group stage matchup
article.story: Atlanta Hawks (11-6, fourth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Boston Celtics (12-6, second in the Eastern Conference) Boston; Friday, 8 p.m. EST LINE: Celtics -9.5; over/under is 222.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Atlanta Hawks visit the Atlanta Hawks in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Celtics have gone 11-2 against Eastern Conference opponents. Boston is 3-4 against opponents over .500. The Hawks are 10-2 in Eastern Conference play. Atlanta scores 116.7 points and has outscored opponents by 3.1 points per game. The Celtics are shooting 44.3% from the field this season, 3.0 percentage points lower than the 47.3% the Hawks allow to opponents. The Hawks are shooting 44.9% from the field, 2.6% higher than the 42.3% the Celtics' opponents have shot this season. TOP PERFORMERS: Derrick White is scoring 12.4 points per game and averaging 3.2 rebounds for the Celtics. Jayson Tatum is averaging 24.8 points and 6.7 rebounds over the last 10 games. Jalen Johnson is scoring 19.1 points per game with 9.1 rebounds and 6.9 assists for the Hawks. Nickeil Alexander-Walker is averaging 22.7 points and 3.8 rebounds while shooting 40.7% over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Celtics: 6-4, averaging 110.8 points, 46.3 rebounds, 26.8 assists, 8.4 steals and 5.0 blocks per game while shooting 43.8% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 98.6 points per game. Hawks: 8-2, averaging 117.0 points, 48.1 rebounds, 30.0 assists, 11.2 steals and 3.9 blocks per game while shooting 44.5% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 112.3 points. INJURIES: Celtics: Mitchell Robinson: day to day (illness). Hawks: CJ McCollum: out (calf), Henri Veesaar: out for season (acl), Jock Landale: day to day (hip), Mouhamed Gueye: out (foot), Asa Newell: out (toe). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
